status: deployed; successful user-consented Gemini request observed

timer.cause: Step 3 alternated between Date.now minus server createdAt and elapsedSeconds from polling. Different wall clocks and response delays caused negative values and backward ticks.
timer.fix: Seed elapsed time once from the server and advance using performance.now. Clamp to nonnegative, nondecreasing integer seconds. Resumed jobs fetch a fresh elapsed value before starting their clock.

gemini.inputs: Original local image or PDF preferred; use the corresponding processed image if the original is unavailable. No arbitrary remote URLs are fetched.
gemini.consent: Only POST /ocr/jobs/<failed-job-id>/gemini/ with the existing job capability and consent=true can create a Gemini job. Regular OCR submissions cannot select the cloud engine.
gemini.retries: One child job per failed parent makes repeated POSTs idempotent. Copy completed file results and process only remaining files. Gemini failures can be retried by explicitly consenting again.
gemini.errors: Empty, unreadable, malformed or incomplete output remains an error. Authentication, quota and timeout messages do not expose provider response bodies or API credentials.
gemini.searchablePdf: No new searchable PDF is generated by Gemini; already completed local PDFs are preserved.
gemini.configurationNote: An initially empty API key is reread from the private .env file, so filling it enables the fallback without restarting active jobs. Changing an already loaded key or model requires a service restart.
